title: Better HTTP/1 connection reuse in Go 1.27
summary: Go 1.27 introduces improved HTTP/1 connection reuse mechanisms, optimizing how the net/http client manages persistent connections to reduce overhead and improve performance for applications making multiple HTTP requests.
problem_solved: Reduces connection overhead and improves HTTP client performance by better reusing existing TCP/TLS connections instead of creating new ones for each request.
why_valuable: Provides measurable performance improvements for Go applications making frequent HTTP requests, reducing latency and resource consumption.
